scripts.build:preview: npm run build:preview:publico && npm run build:preview:privado
scripts.build:preview:publico: VITE_ROUTER=memory VITE_DEMO=1 VITE_PREVIEW_ROLE=public vite build -c vite.preview.config.js --outDir dist-preview/publico && node scripts/make-preview-fragment.mjs publico
scripts.build:preview:privado: VITE_ROUTER=memory VITE_DEMO=1 VITE_PREVIEW_ROLE=admin vite build -c vite.preview.config.js --outDir dist-preview/privado && node scripts/make-preview-fragment.mjs privado
